meta.title: DSH tools
meta.description: Seven utilities: 1) a More menu in the Windows caption bar offering Reload plugins (hot-reload installed plugin code without interrupting sessions) and Restart DSH (⚠ one click restarts immediately; running tasks are interrupted); 2) a Generate button in the composer that drafts an intended reply from the last assistant message; 3) an Optimize button that rewrites the prompt in the composer into a version the AI understands and executes more easily (the composer locks while generating/optimizing and unlocks when done); 4) terminal-style input history — ArrowUp/ArrowDown in the composer cycles through the messages you sent this session; 5) a Source Control entry in the right "Start" toolbar — a VSCode-style panel: scans only the current workspace (follows session switches automatically), browse git changes grouped by repository (groups start collapsed, click to expand), view per-file diffs, commit a checked subset of files as one commit, generate the commit message with AI following each repo's history style, then push; 6) a quick-phrases bar inside the composer card right above the input — click a phrase to insert it at the caret, up to five shown, editable in Tools settings; 7) Settings → Tools: toggle each feature independently, edit quick phrases, pick a faster custom model for generate/optimize, and manage Source Control scan roots. The titlebar button is desktop-only.
